description: Snaps the y-value of a feature placement pos to the floor or the ceiling within the provided 'vertical_search_range'. The placement biome is preserved. If the snap position goes outside of the placement biome, placement will fail.

feature_to_snap.description: Named reference of feature to be snapped.

search_range.description: Range to search for a floor or ceiling for snaping the feature.

surface.description: Defines the surface that the y-value of the placement position will be snapped to.

allow_air_placement.description: Determines whether the feature can snap through air blocks. Defaults to true.

allow_underwater_placement.description: Determines whether the feature can snap through water blocks. Defaults to false.

allow_non_air_replacement.description: Determines whether the feature can snap through non air blocks. Defaults to false, is only used if the snap is started in a block that is not water or air.

embed_in_surface.description: Determines whether the placed feature should be embedded in the found surface.
